texts:
Friday's news, team by team, from Thursday night's box score to the last injury reports.

Mike Evans is cleared.

Bucky Irving ran for 165.

Breece Hall is out again.
#FTTB #GoBucs #JetUp

Mike Evans (ribs) is off San Francisco's final injury report with no designation after a limited Wednesday and a rest day Thursday. He caught 5 of 8 for 76 playing through it vs DEN.

WR24 for me @SEA, a WR2.
#FTTB

Emanuel Wilson keeps the whole Seattle backfield with Zach Charbonnet out. He ran 21 times with 2 TDs vs LAC.

RB16 for me vs SF, an RB2.
#Seahawks

Bucky Irving ran 21 times for 165 and a TD and caught a 5-yard score at DAL. Sean Tucker got 5 carries, Kenneth Gainwell 4.

Irving is RB17 rest of season for me. Hold him; a lost goal-line role two more weeks would change it.
#GoBucs

CeeDee Lamb left Thursday's loss late with a bruised quad after 2 catches for 9. It is reported as not serious, and Dallas gets three extra days.

WR4 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's Week 6 injury report.
#DallasCowboys

Breece Hall (quad) is out vs CLE. Braelon Allen took all 14 back carries at CHI without him.

Allen is RB15 for me this week, an RB2.
#JetUp

Carnell Tate (back) is questionable, and Robert Saleh says he plays. He drew 12 targets, 39 percent of Tennessee's, at BAL.

WR23 for me vs HOU, a WR2.
#TitanUp

David Montgomery ran 10 times for 24 on 32 snaps while Woody Marks scored on 20.

Montgomery is RB21 for me @TEN, an RB2.

Marks is RB35, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play.
#HTownMade

Michael Pittman Jr. is out multiple weeks with the foot. DK Metcalf gets the outside targets.

Metcalf is WR18 for me vs IND, a WR2.

Roman Wilson is WR47, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#HereWeGo

Colston Loveland drew 9 targets with Tyson Bagent, a team high, after 9 in Weeks 1 to 3 combined. Bagent starts again at GB.

TE10 for me this week and TE4 rest of season.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

Saquon Barkley is out in London.

Will Shipley played 28 of 61 snaps vs LAR and stays the lead back. RB22 for me @JAX, an RB2.

Dameon Pierce was signed for an early-down slice.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Dallas Goedert has no designation after missing Weeks 3 and 4 with the MCL. Johnny Mundt goes back to blocking.

Goedert is TE35 for me this week, outside my top 12. Hold him at TE15 rest of season.
#FlyEaglesFly

Romeo Doubs has 2 TDs since A.J. Brown went to IR.

Mack Hollins is hurt too, so the outside targets stay with Doubs.

WR26 for me vs LV, a high-end WR3 and a high-end flex play.
#NEPats #RaiderNation

Tyquan Thornton is out 12 to 16 weeks after ankle surgery. Xavier Worthy takes the vertical routes.

Rashee Rice's hamstring is called minor over the bye. WR20 rest of season for me. Hold him; Wednesday's practice decides it.
#ChiefsKingdom

Tyler Allgeier ran 8 times for 42 and a TD as Jeremiyah Love's workload was managed. Love has no designation.

Allgeier is RB32 for me vs DET, a low-end RB3 and a low-end flex play.
#BirdGang

Keaton Mitchell out-touched Omarion Hampton at SEA, 10 carries and 5 catches to Hampton's 9 carries.

Hampton is RB27 for me vs DEN, a high-end RB3.

Mitchell is RB34, a low-end RB3.
#BoltUp #BroncosCountry

Every item from today is on the Pass, with the Menu refreshed for Friday's reports.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's inactives and pivots, and repost this for your league.
